notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary interaction delivery through explicit regional subscriptions and the implicit default region. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies overlapping and disjoint regional routing, restoration of a retained ordinary subscription after regional unsubscription, ordinary default-region delivery, conveyed empty source-region metadata, and independent region and federation cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary and regional interaction publication, subscription, unsubscription, send, region, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador default-region interaction routing declarations
